fileAudit.limitation: The runner verifies source files against this export manifest on each run. Native development/fresh reports do not embed tokenizer file hashes, so this is not a direct comparison of per-run tokenizer metadata.

timingScope.nativeNeural: Sum of allocated CPU inference batch time per field; excludes tokenization, loading, live DOM collection and network.
timingScope.browserNeural: Actual first forward plus output reduction per pretokenized field batch; excludes tensor preparation, tokenization, loading, live DOM collection and network. Some operators may run on CPU even when GPU submissions are observed. No warm-trial interpretation for one-pass holdout.
timingScope.nodeStructural: Observation featurePack, feature construction, vectorization, linear scoring and selection in Node; excludes live DOM collection and image/network access.
timingScope.browserStructural: Full observed-evidence featurePack, feature construction, vectorization, linear scoring and selection; excludes live DOM collection, image fetch and network. 30 trials of ten full calls per field; first call separately. Browser JS heap is not complete process memory.
timingScope.comparisonLimit: Browser structural elapsedMs is the per-field median of repeated full predictions, while browser neural elapsedMs is a first pass. These scopes are not identical end-to-end OTT navigation latency; firstMs is retained for structural rows.
